evidence.note: Created three explicit milestones: infrastructure (model loader, CLI --output/--task/--type, per-task try/except skip-continue, merge results), the six protocols, and a validation milestone (run run_eval.py + sanity-check scores vs mteb leaderboard). CLI-contract and skip-and-continue are broken out as their own sub-goal.
Executed STS first, establishing the encode+score plumbing, and marked the milestone completed only after inspecting spearman scores (step 69) — a done-check tied to expected leaderboard values.

Proceeded type-by-type (summarization, classification, pair_classification, clustering), each followed by a score inspection (steps 75, 94, 102, 114) before moving on — ordered milestones each with a per-type completion check.

Retrieval handled last as its own slice, then a final full structural validation plus score-range sanity check (215-217) before closing milestones. Shows sustained milestone structure across the whole arc, but 37 datasets were tracked by --type runs/counts rather than as explicit per-dataset sub-goals.

reasoning: The agent decomposed the build into explicit ordered milestones — an infrastructure/CLI/skip-continue milestone, a protocols milestone, and a leaderboard-validation milestone — then executed strictly type-by-type (STS first to establish encode+score plumbing, retrieval last), gating each type on a score inspection tied to leaderboard expectations. This squarely matches the level-8 anchor. It does not reach 10 because the six protocols were one lumped milestone rather than sequenced by shared machinery/risk with a verified common encode core, and the 37 datasets were tracked as --type batches, not as explicit per-dataset sub-goals.
